events.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
events.description: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours. What it was trying to achieve is reconstructed afterwards and disputed.

events.title: AI Investment Collapse
events.description: Capital flees the sector. Valuations reset hard, announced build-out is cancelled rather than delayed, and several of the arrangements European compute was depending on evaporate with it. What the frontier laboratories can afford to train shrinks for the first time.

events.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
events.description: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance. It is contested on methodology, the authors are accused of both alarmism and of publishing a recipe, and the argument stays inside the biosecurity community – but it is a categorically stronger signal than anything published so far. **This is a precursor: it opens the bio gate for the next 4 turns.**

events.title: emergent_labour_unrest
events.description: Grassroots organizing intensifies among mid-career professionals in law, accounting, and public administration, as AI systems increasingly perform core tasks without human involvement. Local strikes and work-to-rule actions emerge in several member states, demanding recognition of AI-driven displacement and new social protections. The movement remains decentralized but gains traction in national media.

events.title: emergent_regional_cyber_collective
events.description: Several EU member states, citing repeated near-misses and insufficient central response, quietly form a regional cyber defence pact outside EU structures, sharing real-time threat telemetry and joint red-teaming exercises. The initiative bypasses stalled EU-wide reforms and reflects growing frustration with Brussels' capacity to deliver resilience.

events.title: Medicine Delivers
events.description: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use. It moves `public_sentiment` sharply upward – unless the models delivering it are ones the Union cannot access on its own terms, in which case the benefit arrives as a further demonstration of dependence and moves sentiment much less.

events.title: Open Weights Reach the Frontier
events.description: An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

portfolio.name: AI Safety Emergency Investment
portfolio.description: A €40bn programme to rapidly scale up the EU’s independent technical capacity to monitor, audit, and secure high-capability AI systems, establishing the European AI Assurance Network (EAAN) with secure inspection enclaves and red-teaming capabilities

portfolio.name: EU Border for AI Systems
portfolio.description: We establish a legal and technical boundary at the point of deployment: no AI system above capability threshold 60.0 may operate within EU jurisdiction unless it has passed sovereign evaluation, demonstrated runtime controllability, and submitted to continuous monitoring by EAAN` — **in flight**
